About PureGym London Hayes
Inside our state-of-the-art gym in Hayes you’ll find everything you need to reach your fitness goals, including our pick of the finest fitness equipment, a packed timetable of fun gym classes, and a top fitness team on hand to inspire and motivate members.
The gym is on Springfield Road Retail Park, near to Wickes, Pets at Home, Wren Living and Topps Tiles.
Members can park for free for max 3 hours * on site - we're located along the A4020 Uxbridge Road, near to the Ossie Garvin Roundabout. Please note, members must validate their parking using the console in-club located near the entrance.
View our gyms in London: Gyms in West London , All gyms in London
We want to keep PureGym a safe environment for everyone to work out. If you plan to train at night or during un-staffed hours ( check your gym’s hours here ), please read our unstaffed hours document here to ensure your safety when at the gym.
Made for how you move
Whether you’re chasing a PB or just feeling good in your body, our equipment is here to help you train your way.
360 virtual tour of London Hayes Gym View 360 tour
Unlimited classes. Unlimited you. Find your flow, from high energy to low impact, every class is included at most gyms – and there’s something for every fitness mood and every kind of mover. View Classes
The friendliest Personal Trainers Work 1-1 with a PT to build confidence, perfect technique and make progress that feels good in and out of the gym. View Personal Trainers
Getting to PureGym
Driving
You'll find us next to Wickes and Screwfix on the Springfield Retail Park.
You can find us at UB4 0UP and can get to us from Hayes Town Centre using the A314 or Broadway Road. Alternatively, use the A4020 Uxbridge Road. The retail park is close to Minet Country Park and opposite Hyatt Place Hotel.
Parking is free on site for up to 3 hours. Members must validate their parking using the console in-club near the entrance. Please note: there is a barrier in operation between 11pm and 5am Monday - Sunday. To enter during this time, members will need to enter their PIN and the barrier will lift. To exit, members need to drive to the markings on the floor and the barrier will lift.
*Parking restrictions may apply. Please check in the car park before you enter the gym. PureGym is not responsible for any parking fines.
